findings.issue: Common noun, feminine plural construct (H6160), is left untranslated as arabot; common nouns stay Spanish.
מוֹאָב is a proper name with the conventional Spanish form Moab. Moav hebraizes the soft bet.
Unmarked de joins Yerijó to Jordán; the second proper name has no preposition and stands in juxtaposition.

notes: Hiphil 3mp, the three אל destinations, the three את objects, the camp, and verbless אשר על match the tokens.
